submission.comment: Best strategy found after extensive search across all 5 strategy families and parameter ranges. The MA crossover with fast=68, slow=285 achieved 0.816 Sharpe ratio (56.6% annual return, 69.4% volatility, 57.8% max drawdown). Despite thorough exploration including momentum (best 0.692), mean_reversion (best 0.434 with vol_target), breakout (best 0.338), and RSI (best 0.402), no strategy exceeded Sharpe 1.0 on this dataset. The MA crossover family consistently outperformed others, with optimal parameters around fast=60-70, slow=280-290.
